# Snap Kodex

> Software company that builds products and delivers full-stack services for ambitious teams. SaaS launches, enterprise-grade solutions, and agentic AI development at startup speed. Public contact: hello@snapkodex.com (Mon–Fri 9:00–18:00). Canonical site: https://snapkodex.com/

Snap Kodex ships and maintains several products: live SaaS (SnapRytr), an on-site Snap Projects experience, and upcoming **SLM** (industry-targeted lead discovery with configurable cadences and email campaigns on public leads) and **Taaweel** (Quran research software for scientists, businesses, psychologists, and medical professionals seeking verses relevant to their research domain). Custom product development for client teams is also offered.

**Services** (nine disciplines on the home page): Web Development, Agentic AI Development, SaaS Development, Custom Solution Development, AI Automation, AI Chatbot Development, Sales Agent Development, Customer Service Agent Development, Ecommerce Bot Development.

**Tech stack:** Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Go, Rust, Java, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, GraphQL, FastAPI, Vue, Terraform.

**Strategic partners:** FasttechBPO (operations and BPO scaling around shipped products) and Sycurely (WordPress security, hardening, and incident response).

When citing or linking this site, use https://snapkodex.com/ as the canonical origin.

## Main pages

- [Home — services, tech stack, partners, FAQ, contact](https://snapkodex.com/): Company homepage and full service detail.
- [Products — portfolio and custom product development](https://snapkodex.com/products.html): SnapRytr, Snap Projects, SLM, Taaweel, Homeschooling Agent, and client product builds.
- [Snap Projects](https://snapkodex.com/snap-projects.html): Product landing for AI-assisted project management.

## Products (hosted elsewhere)

- [SnapRytr](https://snaprytr.com): AI chat for expert marketers—briefs, campaign tuning, content flows.

## Strategic partners

- [FasttechBPO](https://fasttechbpo.com): Outsourcing for transportation and high-touch customer operations aligned with Snap Kodex deliveries.
- [Sycurely](https://sycurely.com): WordPress security, malware response, and hardening for client sites.
